'''Bat Squadron''' was an [[Airam (group)|Airam]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] composed of [[R-41 Starchaser]]s. It was the resident defense unit at [[Goff Platform]] and participated in [[Attack on Goff|the Imperial attack there]]. Tasked with defeating [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]], it and the rest of the Airam defense was outwitted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] pincer attack. Bat Squadron was wiped out to the last [[Starship/Legends|ship]].
